title: Towel Bar 18-Inch Wall Mount Powder Coated Pipe | Antique Bronze | Pipeline Collection | Allied Brass
description:
Stop draping towels over doors and counters—keep bath towels neatly hung and easy to grab with an 18-Inch wall-mounted towel bar designed for everyday use in Antique Bronze, which combines deep brown tones with subtle warm highlights, offering heritage appeal with modern durability.

Highlights:
- Antique Bronze brings rich depth and character
- Choose from 76 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Count on an enduring, decorative finish with a highly durable powder coat
- Maintain a cleaner look over time with corrosion-free and rust-free performance
- Install with confidence using color-coordinated mounting hardware

Specs & Installation:
- Product dimensions (L x H x W): 18 x 3 x 3.3 in.
- Box dimensions (L x H x W): 24 x 5 x 5 in.
- Shipping weight: 2.2 lbs
- Finish: powder coated
- Warranty: limited lifetime warranty
